analysis.description: This image depicts a puja room in a modern Indian home, featuring a traditional diwan with carved wooden elements and a central glass panel displaying religious symbols. The high-gloss marble and dark wood combination gives the space a luxurious yet spiritual ambiance, blending traditional Indian design with contemporary finishes. The use of religious symbols such as the Swastika and Om emphasizes the cultural and spiritual significance of the room.
